# Security policy

## Supported versions

Wuf is alpha software. Security fixes target the newest published release
and the current `main` branch; older alpha releases are not maintained
independently.

## Report a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Email
[mail@jantmueller.com](mailto:mail@jantmueller.com) with:

- the affected version and platform;
- a minimal reproduction or proof of concept;
- the expected impact; and
- any suggested mitigation.

Avoid including unrelated repository contents, credentials, or personal
activity data. You may open an ordinary GitHub issue for non-sensitive bugs.
